letsfg.description: Flight and hotel search & booking for AI agents. Server-side engine covers hundreds of airlines with per-flight reliability history, plus real bookable hotel rates with free cancellation and pay-later terms. ONE credential covers both: the free token from `letsfg auth` (zero-amount card setup, nothing charged) or a Developer API key. Hotels need a card on file — which `letsfg auth` already puts there — and booking charges a 5% non-refundable reservation fee, balance paid to the supplier by balance_due_by.
